evidence: HDAC3 emerged as a candidate and was validated through genetic knockdown and pharmacologic inhibition (RGFP966) in multiple SCLC cell lines.
Both approaches enhanced radiosensitivity, as shown by cell viability (dose modification factor10 = 1.14-1.69) and clonogenic assays (dose modification factor10 = 1.16-1.41).
HDAC3 emerged as a candidate and was validated through genetic knockdown and pharmacologic inhibition (RGFP966) in multiple SCLC cell lines.
